messages:
emily (sales): Acme follow-up: SIG reviewer wants demonstrable KMS rotation + evidence for Private (BYOK) during the POC. Also asked if rotations cause downtime and if export retention affects pricing for Dedicated. Can we confirm and prepare artifacts?
rajesh (security): Short answers: (1) rotations are online (no customer-visible downtime) if we use standard CMEK APIs and rotate keys per-cloud best practice; (2) exports are forwarded to customer storage so retention there doesn't affect our Dedicated compute pricing, only storage egress/storage costs; (3) we can provide rotation logs and an audit trail for SIG.
ben (solutions): Actionable deliverables we should attach to CAIQ: a) one-paragraph CAIQ response about BYOK + rotation, b) screenshot of rotation activity from our Console audit, c) sample rotation commands for AWS/GCP, d) short cost note for Dedicated POC.
olivia (eng): Implementation notes for the evidence: we can capture the key-change event and map it to a control-plane audit entry. That audit entry shows actor (customer-service-account), event_type, and timestamp. We can redact ARN details except for key-id if they want. For the agent-forwarded exports, the storage bucket has object metadata with rotation timestamp.
anita (partner): From a cloud partner POV: For AWS CMEK rotations customers call: 
```bash
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id alias/redwood-byo-key --pending-window-in-days 7
# or rotate per policy: aws kms rotate-key --key-id <key-id>
```
GCP: use gcloud kms keys versions create and set-primary. We'll include sample commands for both.
rajesh (security): CAIQ language suggestion: "Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK) for Private deployments. Customers may rotate keys using their cloud KMS APIs; Redwood retains an audit trail of key-change events and can export rotation events to customer storage. Rotation is performed without service interruption when using prescribed BYOK flows."
emily (sales): Nice. Acme also wants confirmation that retained rotation logs count as evidence for SIG questions (they asked for proof of key lifecycle management).
rajesh (security): Confirmed — rotation audit + export screenshot + runbook steps is acceptable evidence. We'll attach a signed runbook snippet and point them to a sample SIEM entry.
ben (solutions): Pricing callout: for Dedicated the additional cost drivers during POC would be: extra storage for exported logs (billed to customer cloud account), and optional agent licensing if they want node-level forwarding. We'll add a small table to the POC SOW.
olivia (eng): For the demo: propose we show (1) Console: enable BYOK for exports, (2) trigger a rotation and show the control-plane audit entry, (3) verify exported object metadata in S3 contains rotation event. I'll prepare a runbook with exact click path + CLI.
emily (sales): Can we get a small script snippet to demonstrate verifying the audit entry? Acme is technical, they'd like a reproducible check.
olivia (eng): Sure. Sample (redacted) verification using AWS CLI for the export object metadata:
```bash
aws s3api head-object --bucket acme-redwood-exports --key control-plane/audit-2026-03-01.json | jq '.Metadata.rotation_timestamp'
```
That returns the rotation timestamp we add at export time.
rajesh (security): I'll prepare the CAIQ paragraph and a short evidence checklist: rotation screenshot, audit JSON sample, runbook, and SIEM sample events. Set as deliverables in ticket.
infra-bot: Ticket #RDW-5499 created: "Acme BYOK rotation evidence + Dedicated POC cost note" assigned to @rajesh, @olivia, @ben. Due: Wed EOD.
emily (sales): Thanks — I'll offer Acme two demo windows Wed/Thu next week. Ben, Rajesh, Olivia, please upload artifacts to the ticket when ready. :thumbsup:
ben (solutions): I'll draft the POC cost note and add a small retained storage estimate for 30/90/365 day options.
rajesh (security): One last caveat to include in CAIQ: for fully air-gapped on-prem where outbound export is blocked, Redwood cannot perform key rotations on customer-managed KMS and customer must perform rotation and provide signed evidence. Add that to avoid overcommitment.
emily (sales): Good call. I'll reply to Acme with the plan.
